app_control._description: Controls app availability, maintenance messages, and update popups
app_control.message: Welcome to HubSave! A new update is available. Please update to enjoy the fastest download speeds and premium features.

multi_platform_apis._description: Dynamic multi-platform video download APIs. The app detects the platform from URL and routes to the best API.
multi_platform_apis._description_routing: Smart routing: detects platform first → tries platform-specific API → falls back to general APIs → falls back to YoutubeDL engine.

api_1._description: Primary Universal API (Cobalt Community - 100% success rate) - supports ALL platforms: YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X/Twitter, Pinterest, Snapchat, Reddit, Twitch and more

api_2._description: Backup Universal API (Cobalt Community #2) - fallback for all platforms if api_1 fails

api_3._description: Official Cobalt API - third fallback for general downloads

api_4._description: Stories API (Instagram/Facebook/Snapchat Stories) - Cobalt with high success rate for stories content

api_5._description: Snapchat API (no watermark) - specialized for Snapchat Spotlight/Stories with disableMetadata support

api_6._description: X/Twitter API - specialized for X/Twitter videos from all accounts including unverified, with twitterGif support

api_7._description: Pinterest API - specialized for Pinterest videos/images/stories download

api_8._description: TikTok Primary API (Lovetik) - TikTok-specific, no watermark

api_9._description: TikTok Backup API (TikWM) - TikTok HD and no watermark backup

quality_options._description: Available video quality levels shown to user. The app will try each quality from highest to lowest and show only available ones.

ads._description: AdMob advertisement units and controls. Set enabled to true (on) or false (off).
ads._description_ad_units: You can change the ad_unit_id here to switch your ad accounts or units instantly without compiling a new APK.

banner._description: Standard Banner Ad displayed at the bottom of the home screen

interstitial_main._description: Fullscreen Interstitial Ad shown after 3 app launches, and after a video successfully downloads

interstitial_player._description: Fullscreen Interstitial Ad shown every 2nd video player open and every 5 video swipes

rewarded._description: Rewarded Video Ad (currently unused - reserved for future implementation)
